description: Data-driven Banner TV onboarding catalog for the eight sports shown in the onboarding UI.

ordering.uiSortOrder: matches the sport order shown in the current Banner TV onboarding screen

coverage.approach: Bundle stable/current franchise memberships; flag promotion/relegation, qualification, college, and individual-sport memberships as dynamic so the app can resolve them from a live provider.
coverage.dynamicMembershipRule: When membershipType is dynamic, qualification, or individual, an empty teams array is intentional and must not be displayed as a broken/empty team picker.
coverage.recommendedBehavior: If selectionEntityType is player or constructor, route to the matching favorite-entity picker when implemented; otherwise skip team selection when there are no bundled teams.

leagues.name: Caribbean Series
leagues.notes: Representatives change each edition; resolve participants live.

leagues.name: Liga Mexicana de Béisbol
leagues.notes: Use live catalog because club membership can change.

leagues.name: NCAA Division I Baseball
leagues.notes: Hundreds of programs; fetch from live provider rather than bundling a stale list.

leagues.name: NCAA Football
